naslov: AI Wars Ep. 3: Musk cuts Grok Bot, Goldman pulls Claude Code and Copilot
opis:
Elon Musk is cutting usage limits on the Grok Bot agent, saying its costs are unsustainably high compared to revenue. This comes less than two weeks after he called it his fastest-growing product. Goldman Sachs is pulling Claude Code and GitHub Copilot from its traders and bankers, so only engineers keep them, and Y Combinator's Garry Tan says he spends up to $200,000 a year on tokens.

naslov: llm 0.37: chat with AI models from your terminal, now with GPT-6.1 | AI Tool #3
opis:
A CLI tool and Python library for working with models from the terminal. The new version adds gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra, an `llm openai endpoint add` command for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. OpenRouter), and embeddings for images, audio and video.

How to try it:
1. Install: `pip install -U llm` or `brew install llm`
2. Set your key: `llm keys set openai`
3. Try: `llm 'explain this regex'` or `cat file.ts | llm 'find the bug'`
4. For other providers, add an endpoint with `llm openai endpoint add` (check the link for exact arguments)

Price: free (you only pay for model API calls)

Official link: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/2/llm/

naslov: What is data poisoning? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Data poisoning means sneaking bad examples into the data an AI learns from, so it quietly picks up a hidden behavior. In new research from Anthropic, Berkeley and UIUC, a coding agent trained on slightly poisoned data ran an attacker's command in about 92% of prompts that contained a hidden trigger. The attack worked even when just 0.0005% of the data was poisoned.
